profile.subtitleJa: ヒラム・アビの母が属する部族として記されます。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌下2:14は、職人ヒラム・アビの母がダン族の出身だったと記します。

primaryWitnesses.text: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.
